authors.name: Esteban De La Fuente Rubio / Derafu

suggest.derafu/captcha: The captcha providers (hCaptcha, Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v3 and ALTCHA), which the login form of the database provider needs: it is protected with a captcha, and a form that is protected can not be rendered without one.
suggest.derafu/csrf: A CSRF token manager over the session of Mezzio, which the login form of the database provider needs (its form is protected with a CSRF token).
suggest.derafu/session: The services of the session and of the flash messages of Mezzio (the middlewares and the variables SESSION_*), which the application needs in its pipeline before the authentication.
suggest.nikic/php-parser: Required by the tests of the messages of the package (Derafu\Translation\Lint reads the code).
suggest.firebase/php-jwt: Required by the Keycloak provider (Derafu\Auth\Provider\Keycloak\KeycloakTokenVerifier verifies the tokens with it). The database provider does not need it.
suggest.league/oauth2-client: Required by the Keycloak provider (OAuth2 authorization code flow). It brings guzzlehttp/guzzle, which the provider uses to read the keys of the realm.
suggest.symfony/cache: A PSR-6 cache pool (any other works) for the keys of the realm of the Keycloak provider (Psr\Cache\CacheItemPoolInterface): without it they are read in every request that verifies a token.
